raw: {"verdict": "pass", "reason": "The Note textarea has a real label (htmlFor/id), a 500-character limit, and a counter. The API trims the note, stores empty or whitespace-only notes as NULL, and rejects notes over 500 characters through the existing zod 400 path. The admin card renders the note as escaped plain text with whitespace-pre-wrap, so line breaks are kept. The 500 limit is counted in UTF-16 units, so emoji count as two, which I judged an acceptable reading of 'characters'."}
